scope.endpointPolicy: Keep the existing six native DOMAIN_START fights and intermediate HP<50%/KO round-trip recovery. Then use the same shortest-roundtrip/price-ranked legal inn selection and actual MOVE/road combats; BUY only if HP is missing, and stop at that inn without return travel.
scope.alreadyFullHpPolicy: Already-full party still MOVE/PLACE_ENTER to the selected inn, but does not BUY unnecessary lodging. No lodging transaction input/fee is charged; move inputs are charged.
scope.originalReturnPolicyPreserved: Existing --final-recovery still returns to the farming map and can take new road damage after its last inn BUY. These earlier observed rows and costs are preserved, but are not an identical full-HP endpoint comparison.

assumptions.enemy: Native fixed four-person rule; no enemy stat/action edits.
assumptions.fixtures: Owned allies, equal levels/legal phase and talents, equal weapon/armor/accessory enhancement; no constellations or artifacts. One initial full HP only.
assumptions.actions: Native public COMBAT actions. Traveler Q then hold E; Isekai E marks a fresh highest-HP target then Q; alternate Q-first can be requested.
assumptions.recovery: Native MOVE with incidental battles and BUY lodging at HP below 50% or death; HP/PRNG carried between all fights.
assumptions.time: Displayed 2x uses internal rate 1 and presentationMs / 1000; 3 seconds per combat input, 6 seconds receipt/reentry, 4 seconds per move, 10 seconds lodging input/processing.
assumptions.limits: Human/network latency and acquisition grind excluded. Starting money is diagnostic funding, not income. Exact matchup outcomes are sampled, not a promise every composition wins.
assumptions.endpoint: After the six native main fights, MOVE to the same selected legal inn and BUY only if HP is missing; stop there with actual full HP, without return travel. Intermediate recovery and input/time policy are unchanged.
